ns2:course.label: Contemp Issues in AgAccy&Fin
ns2:course.description: Students study contemporary issues and career opportunities in AgriAccounting and AgriFinance in this course. An in-depth dialogue with industry professionals helps develop an understanding of the skill sets needed to succeed in each of the different career paths discussed. May not be repeated for credit.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: May not be repeated for credit.
ns2:course.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Agr & Consumer Economics department.
